english.title: Pollute / do act to pollute fountain or / bathe / enter fountain within Trafalgar Square
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Trafalgar Square

(A)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), which polluted or was likely to pollute water in a fountain]_
(B)_[bathed in or otherwise entered a fountain or fountain bowl]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 3(1)(a) of the Trafalgar Square Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3)(b) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: (i) As per byelaw 3(2) the offence does not apply to authorised persons, members of the armed forces and any fire brigade or ambulance service acting in the performance of his duty when doing anything reasonably necessary for the performance of that duty.(ii) As per byelaw 9 where an authorised person has reasonable ground for belief that a person has contravened any one or more of the Byelaws, that person shall give on demand his name and address to that authorised person.
